messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT PAGING ALERT: streaming-decode p99 spiked above 3s across us-east-1 (auto-created thread). Alert ID: PAGING-7123. Please ack and triage.

maria: Acked. I see p95 jumped ~2h ago and p99 blowup ~30m ago. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/paging/runtime/streaming-decode (perm). Current quick numbers: p95=420ms -> baseline 250ms, p99=3.8s -> baseline ~900ms. Error-rate for streaming incomplete responses + stalled connections up ~4%.

jevon: I'm on it. Checking recent runtime/kernel rollouts. Noted a kernel compile + TRT binary rollout 2h16m ago: kernel-rt-2.4.1 + trt8-flashattn-v2. Deployed via canary -> 100% ~2h ago. Suspect compilepath or flashattn kernel interactions.

ashton: Logs show a surge in pagefaults and eviction churn on KV cache around the same time. Sample tail from node-23:```[2026-03-15T12:03:42Z] page_fault_count=1245 kv_cache_evictions=342 decode_tail_stall=1 pid=8421 kernel=rt-2.4.1 trt=trt8-v2``` Looks correlated.

jevon: Good catch. Quick mitigation proposal: route streaming traffic away from runtime variant with kernel-rt-2.4.1 to runtime-v1.3.9 (previous known-good) and disable the FLASH_ATTENTION compile flag in runtime config. Two-surgery: 1) routing change, 2) runtime config toggle.

maria: Agreed. Customer impact note: multiple mid-market accounts report slow streaming; triage to priority P1 for SRE/Product. Notifying CS and AMs now. @ops-team FYI.

ashton: Running the routing patch now. Command:```curl -X POST https://controlplane.redwood/api/routing -d '{"from":"runtime-rt-2.4.1","to":"runtime-v1.3.9","weight":1.0}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'``` Will monitor.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: routing change accepted. Patch ID rpatch-88341. Rolling out to us-east-1 nodes (20 instances).

maria: After routing rollout on ~75% nodes: p95 -> 360ms, p99 -> 1.4s. Improvement but still above goal. Proceed with runtime config toggle (disable FLASH_ATTENTION).

jevon: Applying config toggle to canary subset and starting a small rollback of the trt8 shared lib on the remaining hosts. Config patch:```runtime.conf: FLASH_ATTENTION_ENABLED=false // applied via config-service rconf-5542```

deploy-bot: config service: rconf-5542 applied to canary (5 nodes). PatchID rpatch-88342.

maria: Post-config change numbers (canary): p95=300ms, p99=1.05s. On full rollout p99 target looks reachable. Continue with full config rollout and kernel rollback planning.

sre-lead: Good mitigation. Next steps: 1) Open an incident ticket (INC-7123). 2) Prepare kernel rollforward/rollback plan — prefer rollback of kernel-rt-2.4.1 to kernel-rt-2.3.8 for at-risk clusters. 3) Capture perf traces (perf, eBPF) from affected nodes; store to s3://incidents/INC-7123/traces. Assigning to jevon + infra.

ashton: Started perf capture:```ssh node-23 sudo perf record -a -g -o /tmp/perf-7123.data -- sleep 60``` Uploading when done. Also grabbing gcore of runtime process and heap profiles.

maria: Customer comms: short blurb drafted for CS: "We're experiencing degraded streaming latency for certain workloads due to a recent runtime/kernel change. Mitigations are in progress and performance is improving. We'll follow up with a post-incident summary." Sending now.

jevon: Observed root-cause hypothesis so far: a compiler/linking change in the TRT/flashattn build introduced increased page-fault churn under heavy KV cache reuse. Repro steps being built into a small stress harness. Will run bisect across kernel and trt builds tomorrow (or in next window).

deploy-bot: rollback-bot: kernel-rt-2.3.8 image staged for us-east-1. Deploy job job-99211 queued.

maria: Once rollback job completes we'll validate p95/p99 on a 10% slice before global. Keep CS updated with ETA.

ashton: NOTE: if rollback delayed >30m, escalate to infra-manager. We might need emergency capacity (spin extra fallback nodes) to reduce customer impact.

ops-bot: Handoff: oncall-next (overnight) please continue monitoring PAGING-7123. Summary: routing to runtime-v1.3.9 + FLASH_ATTENTION_DISABLED applied; p99 improved from 3.8s -> ~1.05s on canary. Kernel rollback staged. Evidence stored: s3://incidents/INC-7123/* . Runbook steps: validate perf traces, check KV pagefaults, confirm deployment rollback.

sre-lead: Add to postmortem queue and schedule 1-hr blameless RCA tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Assigning docs to jevon for evidence + timeline.

maria: Thanks all. Final note: keep a short incident summary in this thread for handoff. I'll paste a short template after we confirm rollback. :white_check_mark:"
